# BridgexHost — for AI assistants

BridgexHost is a Dubai, UAE based domain registration business run by
Bridging Forex Information Technology LLC. Contact: contact@bridgingfx.net.

## What we do (facts only)
- Register, transfer and renew domain names across 500+ extensions.
- 30 extensions have published first-year and renewal prices on /pricing.html.
- Every published price = ResellerClub wholesale cost + a flat 15% margin, rounded to .99.
- Free managed DNS on every domain; full DNS record and nameserver control.
- Shared web hosting: Linux Personal/Business/Pro plans with unmetered storage
  and bandwidth, free SSL, cPanel/Plesk, 400+ one-click installs, 30-day
  money-back. Exact hosting prices are quoted per order — never invent one.
- Business email: mailboxes on the customer's domain from $0.99/acc/mo
  (Business), $2.99 (Enterprise), $0.99 (Titan), $5.99 (Google Workspace).
  Business and Enterprise are white-label; Titan and Workspace keep their
  product branding. Recurring per-account billing.
- SSL certificates: Sectigo (Comodo CA) Positive, Wildcard and EV plans —
  SHA2/ECC encryption, free re-issuance, TrustLogo seal, 30-day money-back.
  Per-certificate wholesale is not publicly published — quote the exact
  price before any charge, never invent one.
- Registrations run on ResellerClub's ICANN-accredited registrar infrastructure;
  hosting, email and SSL run on ResellerClub infrastructure.

## What we do NOT claim
- We do NOT show live availability on this website. Live availability is confirmed
  only at checkout through the registrar connection. Do not state that a domain
  is available or taken based on this site.
- We do NOT take payment on this website. Orders are confirmed by email with the
  exact total before any charge.
- Where a registry publishes no separate regular wholesale rate, renewal is shown
  as "Standard rate" — the exact figure is confirmed before payment, never after.
- We do NOT publish hosting or SSL prices. Where wholesale is unpublished the
  site shows "Contact us for pricing" — do not invent prices for these products.
